arxiv-2007-11624.title: Tailoring Term Truncations for Electronic Structure Calculations Using a Linear Combination of Unitaries
arxiv-2007-11624.creator: Richard Meister, Simon C. Benjamin, Earl T. Campbell
arxiv-2007-11624.description: Abstract A highly anticipated use of quantum computers is the simulation of complex quantum systems including molecules and other many-body systems. One promising method involves directly applying a linear combination of unitaries (LCU) to approximate a Taylor series by truncating after some order.

arxiv-2112-08157.title: Investigating Signatures of Phase Transitions in Neutron-Star Cores
arxiv-2112-08157.creator: R. Somasundaram, I. Tews, J. Margueron
arxiv-2112-08157.description: Abstract Neutron stars explore matter at the highest densities in the universe such that their inner cores might undergo a phase transition from hadronic to exotic phases, e.g., quark matter. Such a transition could be associated with non-trivial structures in the density behavior of the speed of sound such as jumps and sharp peaks.

arxiv-2409-15420.title: Dusty substructures induced by planets in ALMA disks: how dust growth and dynamics changes the picture
arxiv-2409-15420.creator: Alexandros Ziampras, Prakruti Sudarshan, Cornelis P. Dullemond, Mario Flock, Vittoria Berta, Richard P. Nelson, Andrea Mignone
arxiv-2409-15420.description: Abstract Protoplanetary disks exhibit a rich variety of substructure in millimeter continuum emission, often attributed to unseen planets. As these planets carve gaps in the gas, dust particles can accumulate in the resulting pressure bumps, forming bright features in the dust continuum.

arxiv-2409-18706.title: The Polarised IKKT Matrix Model
arxiv-2409-18706.creator: Sean A. Hartnoll and Jun Liu
arxiv-2409-18706.description: Abstract We establish a correspondence between a supersymmetric mass deformation of the IKKT matrix integral at large N N and a background of Euclidean type IIB string theory. Both sides have sixteen supersymmetries and an S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) × S ​ O ​ ( 7 ) SO(3)\times SO(7) symmetry.

arxiv-2410-03832.title: Formation and evolution of binary black holes in N N -body simulations of star clusters with up to two million stars
arxiv-2410-03832.creator: Jordan Barber, Fabio Antonini
arxiv-2410-03832.description: Abstract Understanding binary black hole (BBH) dynamics in dense star clusters is key to interpreting the gravitational wave detections by LIGO and Virgo. Here, we perform N N -body simulations of star clusters, focusing on BBH formation mechanisms, dynamical evolution and merging properties.

arxiv-2506-21083.title: Exploring Dark Energy via Non-Minimal Coupling in f ⁡ ( Q , L m ) f(Q,L_{m}) Gravity with Gong-Zhang Parameterization
arxiv-2506-21083.creator: Yash B. Ingole, K.V. Somwanshi, S.R. Bhoyar, S.N. Bayaskar
arxiv-2506-21083.description: Abstract Abstract: In this study, we investigate the late-time accelerated expansion of the universe within the framework of non-minimally coupled f ⁡ ( Q , L m ) f(Q,L_{m}) gravity, where Q Q is the non-metricity scalar and L m L_{m} is the matter Lagrangian.

arxiv-2508-09339.title: UltraLight Med-Vision Mamba for Classification of Neoplastic Progression in Tubular Adenomas Thanks: The authors graciously thank the South Bend Medical Foundation (SBMF) for providing the whole slide images for this work.
arxiv-2508-09339.creator: Aqsa Sultana 1 , Nordin Abouzahra 1 , Ahmed Rahu, MD 2 , Brian Shula 3 , Brandon Combs 4 , Derrick Forchetti, MD 4 , Theus Aspiras, PhD 1 , Vijayan K. Asari, PhD 1
arxiv-2508-09339.description: Abstract Identification of precancerous polyps during routine colonoscopy screenings is vital for their excision, lowering the risk of developing colorectal cancer. Advanced deep learning algorithms enable precise adenoma classification and stratification, improving risk assessment accuracy and enabling personalized surveillance protocols that optimize patient outcomes.

arxiv-2508-16807.title: Autonomous UAV Flight Navigation in Confined Spaces: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
arxiv-2508-16807.creator: Marco S. Tayar, Lucas K. de Oliveira, Juliano D. Negri, Thiago H. Segreto, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker
arxiv-2508-16807.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marco S. Tayar, Lucas K. de Oliveira, Juliano D. Negri, Thiago H. Segreto, Ricardo V. Godoy, Marcelo Becker. Inspecting confined industrial infrastructure, such as ventilation shafts, is a hazardous and inefficient task for humans. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer a promising alternative, but GPS-denied environments require robust control policies to prevent collisions.

arxiv-2511-19066.title: Mitigating Participation Imbalance Bias in Asynchronous Federated Learning
arxiv-2511-19066.creator: Xiangyu Chang, Manyi Yao, Srikanth V. Krishnamurthy, Christian R. Shelton, Anirban Chakraborty, Ananthram Swami, Samet Oymak, Amit Roy-Chowdhury
arxiv-2511-19066.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiangyu Chang, Manyi Yao, Srikanth V. Krishnamurthy, Christian R. Shelton, Anirban Chakraborty, Ananthram Swami, Samet Oymak, Amit Roy-Chowdhury. In Asynchronous Federated Learning (AFL), the central server immediately updates the global model with each arriving client’s contribution. As a result, clients perform their local training on different model versions, causing information staleness (delay).

arxiv-2602-10277.title: Blind source separation for imaging
arxiv-2602-10277.creator: Randy Bartels, Olivier Pinaud
arxiv-2602-10277.description: Abstract This work is concerned with the problem of blind source separation and its applications to imaging. We first establish a theoretical result that we stated in our previous article [ 2 ] on imaging in diffusive environments. This result is a generalization of separability criteria found in the literature to arbitrary correlated complex-valued sources with additive noise.

pmc-10720129.title: Magnitude and time course of insulin resistance accumulation with the risk of cardiovascular disease: an 11-years cohort study
pmc-10720129.creator: Xue Tian, Shuohua Chen, Qin Xu, Xue Xia, Yijun Zhang, Penglian Wang, Shouling Wu, Anxin Wang
pmc-10720129.description: BackgroundThe risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) depended on the magnitude and exposure duration of insulin resistance (IR). This study aimed to investigate the associations of cumulative metabolic score for IR (cumMETS-IR) with incident CVD, and to further explore the modulated effects of time course of METS-IR accumulation.

pmc-11499925.title: Reversible hydrogen storage in Y2C MXene under the influence of functional groups (F, Cl, OH)
pmc-11499925.creator: Thanasee Thanasarnsurapong, Suchanuch Sringamprom, Weekit Sirisaksoontorn, Sirichok Jungthawan, Thanayut Kaewmaraya, Adisak Boonchun
pmc-11499925.description: The hydrogen storage potential of the bare MXenes Y2C and terminated Y2CT2, where T is O, OH, or F, were studied using density functional theory (DFT). Hydrogen adsorption and desorption behaviors are simulated by ab initio molecular dynamic simulations. The interaction of the H2-molecules on the Y2C-family was investigated within the projected density of states.

pmc-11690689.title: ADVANCING THE SCIENCE OF SENSORY HEALTH AND COGNITION: FROM EPIDEMIOLOGY TO INTERVENTION
pmc-11690689.creator: Carrie Nieman, Jennifer Deal
pmc-11690689.description: Sensory health and cognition are at the intersection of two major public health challenges facing an aging global population. Sensory impairments are among the most common and disabling comorbidities among individuals at risk for cognitive impairment and those already aging with cognitive impairment. Sensory impairments may also serve as key biomarkers in dementia and may worsen the trajectory of decline.

pmc-11710592.title: Inhibition of bone morphogenetic protein signaling prevents tau pathology
pmc-11710592.creator: Amira Affaneh, Anne K Linden, Elif Tunc‐Ozcan, Yung‐Hsu Tsai, Chian‐Yu Peng, John A Kessler
pmc-11710592.description: BackgroundAging is the most significant risk factor for neurodegenerative tauopathies, including Alzheimer’s disease (AD), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), and others. However, no specific age‐related molecular change in the brain has been identified that leads to disease onset and progression. We have found age‐related increases in bone morphogenic protein (BMP) signaling in both human and mouse brains.

pmc-11716406.title: The effect of AD co‐pathology on cognitive phenotype and FDG‐PET patterns in Parkinson’s disease with cognitive impairment
pmc-11716406.creator: Sandra Castro‐Labrador, Jesús Silva‐Rodríguez, Miguel Labrador‐Espinosa, Laura Muñoz‐Delgado, Pablo Franco‐Rosado, Ana María Castellano Guerrero, Daniel Macías‐García, Silvia Jesús Maestre, Astrid Adarmes‐Gómez, Elena Ojeda‐Lepe, Fátima Carillo, Juan Francisco Martín Rodríguez, San Eufrasio M, Crist
pmc-11716406.description: BackgroundCo‐morbid Alzheimer’s disease (AD) pathology is a major risk factor for cognitive impairment (CI) in PD, but whether and how AD co‐pathology affects the clinical phenotype of PD‐CI is incompletely understood. Recently validated plasma biomarkers for AD pathology, such as ptau217, hold great promise to revolutionize the diagnosis of neurodegenerative diseases.

pmc-12404726.title: Determination of epidemiological cut-off values for Narasin, Salinomycin, Lasalocid and Monensin in Enterococcus faecium
pmc-12404726.creator: Maria Laura Ferrando, Francesca Saluzzo, Rikki Franklin Frederiksen, Jannice Schau Slettemeås, Anne Margrete Urdahl, Roger Simm, Magdalena Skarżyńska, Magdalena Zając, Anna Lalak, Jowita Niczyporuk, Dariusz Wasyl, Léa Duval, Florence Tardy, Claire Schapendonk, Michel Rapallini, Giovanni Tosi, Simona
pmc-12404726.description: ObjectivesTo establish epidemiological cut-off values (ECOFFs) for the polyether ionophores narasin, salinomycin, lasalocid and monensin in Enterococcus faecium.MethodsMICs were measured using the broth microdilution method according to ISO 20776-1 (2019). Method validation involved ≥10 replicates of antimicrobial susceptibility testing of Enterococcus faecalis ATCC 29212. A total of 182 E. faecium isolates from various sources were tested in five European laboratories.

pmc-12432194.title: Conductive cellulosic pulp composites reinforced with copper-silica hybrid
pmc-12432194.creator: Hoda Sabry Othman, Azza Abbas M. Ward, Sawsan Dacrory, Galal A. M. Nawwar
pmc-12432194.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The rice straw pulp black liquor (RSBL) is high-alkalinity wastewater rich in silica, which renders its known use as a fuel in pulping mills difficult. We explored the economic utilization of RSBL via alkaline precipitation, affording metal lignin/silica hybrids. Our current study focuses on exploring the electrical characteristics of newly developed composites by integrating different ratios of a prepared conductive copper/lignin/silica (Cu–LSF) hybrid into rice straw cellulosic pulp, produced through solar pulping.

pmc-12472666.title: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in the Very Elderly: Clinical, Electrodiagnostic, and Ultrasound Features in a Cohort of 187 Patients
pmc-12472666.creator: Lisa B E Shields, Vasudeva G Iyer, Theresa Kluthe, Yi Ping Zhang, Christopher B Shields, Endre Pál
pmc-12472666.description: Background/Objectives: Elderly patients with carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) have more severe clinical, ultrasonic, and electrodiagnostic (EDX) findings compared to younger patients. Thenar weakness and atrophy are more common at initial presentation in the elderly population with CTS. Methods: This is a retrospective review of 187 very elderly patients (aged 80 years and older) with EDX confirmation of CTS.

pmc-12731037.title: Impact of Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy on Outcomes in Septic Shock Patients Receiving Polymyxin B Hemoperfusion: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12731037.creator: Wei-Hung Chang, Sheng Hsiung Yang, Hsiu-Fang Shen, Ting-Yu Hu, Wen-Jui Wu
pmc-12731037.description: Background: Polymyxin B hemoperfusion (PMX-HP) is increasingly used as an adjunctive therapy for severe sepsis and septic shock, yet the prognostic significance of continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) and vasoactive-inotropic score (VIS) dynamics under real-world ICU practice remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate whether CRRT requirement and hemodynamic responses to PMX-HP influence short-term mortality among critically ill patients.

pmc-13230797.title: Immunoprophylactic potential against pneumonia caused by indigenous isolates of Klebsiella pneumoniae and Streptococcus pneumoniae in experimental mice
pmc-13230797.creator: Iram Waqar, Imran Altaf, Rasheeda Bashir, Kunza Latif, Mehraj A Abbasov
pmc-13230797.description: Pneumonia is a life threatening public health concern particularly due to multidrug resistant (MDR) bacterial pathogens. The rising threat of these resistant bacterial strains has exacerbated the challenge of treating bacterial pneumonia, emphasizing the urgent need of alternative therapeutic strategies such as vaccine development by targeting combined localized MDR bacterial pneumonia pathogens.

pmc-13241616.title: The constrained brain in multiple sclerosis: Cognitive impairment is related to network-specific coupling of structural and functional connectivity
pmc-13241616.creator: Marloes DA Bet, Maureen van Dam, Tommy AA Broeders, Aurélie Ruet, Frederik Barkhof, Eva MM Strijbis, Linda Douw, Ismail Koubiyr, Hanneke E Hulst, Menno M Schoonheim
pmc-13241616.description: BackgroundCognitive impairment in multiple sclerosis (MS) is related to abnormal structural and functional brain network changes. As both modalities have mostly been studied separately, structure connectivity-function coupling (SC-FC) may elucidate how function is constrained by structure.ObjectivesWe examine how changes in SC-FC and its dynamics SC-FC (dSC-FC) may underlie MS-related cognitive impairment.

pmc-13325785.title: Therapeutic leukapheresis with severe pertussis: evaluating efficacy, feasibility, and safety
pmc-13325785.creator: Yixin Gao, Ding Liu, Zitian Lu, Zhijiang Chen, Gang Wang, Minghui Yang, Linyan Wu, Shaowen Li, Yongzheng Peng, Guoqiang Liang
pmc-13325785.description: BackgroundSevere pertussis with hyperleukocytosis (WBC ≥ 50 × 109/L) carries high mortality in infants. While exchange transfusion (ET) is a commonly recommended intervention, it is resource-intensive and non-selective. Therapeutic leukapheresis (TL) offers targeted leukoreduction but lacks robust pediatric evaluation in pertussis. We assessed TL’s efficacy, safety, and feasibility compared to ET.

pmc-13630726.title: Integrating network analysis and machine learning to explore the pharmacological targets and associations of oleanolic acid in lung adenocarcinoma
pmc-13630726.creator: Ying Zeng, Hongting Jiang, Fei Zhang, Cha Luo, Zhonglian Wang, Zhiming Ren, Zhihao Xu, Wen Li, Qing Ye, Wei Jian, Jing Zhang, Qiaofen Fu
pmc-13630726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), a major type of non-small cell lung cancer, has high incidence and mortality rates. Oleanolic acid (OA), a natural pentacyclic triterpene compound, has demonstrated potential anti-tumor effects but its pharmacological effects in LUAD remain unclear.PurposeThis study aims to identify the potential targets and action pathways of OA in LUAD using network analysis, transcriptomics, molecular docking, animal experiments, and preliminary clinical sample assessment.MethodsPotential candidate genes for OA in LUAD were identified from public databases including PubChem, GeneCards, and TCGA.
